whenToUse: Each item needs several actions, such as rename, duplicate, and delete.
There's no room to lay out every action as a button.
You hide rarely used secondary actions so the main ones stand out.
whenNotToUse: It's an input that picks one value (use a select or a radio group).
Even the most frequent action would be hidden in the menu.
There are only two actions, which can be shown as buttons.

alternatives.name: Context Menu
alternatives.reason: The same list of actions, opened by right-click or long press.

alternatives.name: Bottom Sheet
alternatives.reason: Gathering actions at the bottom, within easy reach on mobile.

alternatives.name: Select
alternatives.reason: Choosing a value rather than an action.

accessibility: Give the trigger aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded, the menu role="menu", and items role="menuitem".
Opening with Enter, Space, or ↓ focuses the first item and ↑ the last; ↑↓, Home, and End move between items.
Typing a letter moves to the next item starting with it, skipping disabled items.
Esc closes it and returns focus to the trigger; icon-only triggers get an aria-label.
